security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset: https://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Personal AI master server desktop client
bundle.longDescription: Lucifer is the personal AI master server desktop client. Connects to your home Lucifer master via mTLS gRPC, runs local Ollama, mirrors the personal knowledge graph, and queues actions while offline.
